items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: They gave me a letter you know saying that I was a Guggenheim (Kouganheim?) Fellow

ctx.x: Yes I think it is. And certainly in terms of the honor that comes along with it, it's quite a distinguished award.

I haven't had occasion to lean on that yet but I'll be glad to when I can. They gave me a letter you know saying that I was a Guggenheim (Kouganheim?) Fellow and a "to whom it may concern" type of letter. I keep it with me though just in case I may need it.

It should be part of your archives, yes, yes. You of course, alone these many years have devoted these many years, have met many famous musicians. I'm wondering if there are some who stand out in your mind as just superior humans, as opposed to being musicians?
